Title: Technical Functional Analyst
Title reason: DOMAIN_AMBIGUITY

# About Capco
Capco is a global business and technology consultancy specializing in financial services.
We work with leading financial institutions to solve complex business challenges, modernize technology and deliver meaningful change.
At Capco, you will join a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment where you can grow your expertise and make an impact.
# About the Team
You will join Capco's technology consulting team, working with solution architects, engineers, analysts and delivery specialists on complex systems within financial services.
Together, you will help clients evolve applications and integrations that need to remain reliable while their technology landscape changes.
The team combines detailed technical analysis with an understanding of how banking processes work in practice.
# The Role
We are looking for a Functional & Technical Analyst who can investigate how applications work end to end and turn complex requirements into precise, implementable solution designs.
You will sit close to the technology: analyzing APIs, data flows, application components and integrations across modern and legacy systems.
Working with architects and development teams, you will define how systems should interact, challenge technical assumptions and help resolve issues through testing and production.
Your functional understanding will help ensure that the solution also meets the underlying business need.
# What You Will Do
- Map end-to-end application flows and identify how services, databases, interfaces and existing platforms depend on one another.
- Analyze and specify API integrations, including contracts, request and response structures, data mapping, error handling and interactions with back-end systems.
- Translate functional needs into detailed technical specifications, diagrams, user stories and acceptance criteria that developers and testers can work from.
- Work with solution architects and engineers to assess solution options, reuse existing services and identify integration constraints and technical risks.
- Investigate data and system behavior using SQL, API tools, application documentation and other available diagnostic information.
- Support integration and end-to-end testing, prepare test scenarios and data, and help teams resolve defects by tracing issues across system boundaries.
- Analyze production incidents, identify root causes and coordinate practical fixes with development and support teams.
- Maintain clear documentation of application architecture, interface behavior and changes throughout delivery and release.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to validate that technical designs and delivered solutions meet their needs.
# What You Will Bring
- Experience in technical analysis, solution analysis or software engineering, with the ability to translate functional requirements into technical designs.
- Proven experience with APIs and system integration, including the analysis or design of API contracts and data exchanges between applications.
- Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, with the ability to investigate data flows and troubleshoot issues.
- The ability to understand application architecture, trace end-to-end processing across multiple systems and document it clearly using diagrams and technical specifications.
- Experience supporting integration testing, defect analysis and the resolution of production issues.
- Familiarity with Agile software delivery and effective collaboration with architects, developers, testers and business stakeholders.
- Strong analytical and communication skills, with a structured approach to solving technically complex problems.
- Professional proficiency in Dutch or French and English, both spoken and written.
Experience in banking or another regulated sector, and exposure to both modern services and legacy platforms, will be valuable.
A background in Java or .NET environments, and familiarity with REST, Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, UML, BPMN, Jira or Confluence, can help you get up to speed.
# Why Join Capco?
At Capco, you can work on challenging transformation initiatives with leading financial institutions while developing your skills alongside experienced business and technology professionals.
You will be part of an international, inclusive team that values curiosity, collaboration and the freedom to #BeYourselfAtWork.
# Ready to Take the Next Step?
If you enjoy getting to the bottom of how systems work and designing integrations that hold up in practice, we would love to hear from you.

> # About Lume and Mando
> Founded in 2017, Lume is a transformative personal care brand on a mission to normalize body odor beyond pits and provide people with outrageously effective solutions so they don’t have to think twice about odor.

> Driven by a mission to “Create Things People Like More,” the company is creating a new model—and home—for brands, founders, and talent looking to solve unmet needs, improve peoples’ lives and ultimately change the status quo.
> Even as we grow, we take extra care to maintain the small, scrappy, entrepreneurial culture that helped to get us where we are today: a company that people like more, that better serves its customers, employees, and community.
> Mammoth Brands is committed to making a positive impact and donated over $20 million through our network of nonprofit partners to date.
> We build brands that move fast and think big — and we hire people who are curious about AI, willing to experiment with it in their day-to-day work, and excited to accelerate what's possible.
> We prioritize giving our team the tools, training, and space to build real fluency, so you grow alongside the technology and help shape how we use it.
# About the Team
The Centralized Insights & Analytics (CIA) team is a critical function that drives proactive insights-to-action within the US Personal Care organization.
The CIA organization unites capabilities across data science, analytics, insights, and category management into an integrated function to translate insights into action for everyday decisions and more complex business questions, helping shape the future of our business strategy and enabling us to best serve our customers.
Capabilities built by this team will meaningfully impact the business through marketing optimization, channel strategy, site optimization, selling stories, thought leadership, innovation, and overall consumer/shopper experience.
# About the Role
As the Analytics Manager for DTC, you'll build and drive the reporting and diagnostic analytics that advance our strategy - and turn that analysis into a point of view.
You'll design and report on DTC KPIs and analyses spanning the user journey from acquisition through conversion, post-purchase engagement and retention, subscriptions, distribution, and site experimentation.
When a stakeholder brings you a question, they should walk away with a recommendation, not just a chart or data point - that means connecting the dots across data sources, business priorities, and customer signal, and knowing which questions are worth chasing and which aren't.
We need someone with strong business acumen, excellent storytelling skills, a passion for consumer empathy, a robust technical toolkit, and the confidence to share a strong point of view, even with people more senior than you.
You'll work with key decision-makers throughout the DTC organization, and share your insights and recommendations - and defend them - with all levels of the business.
# Here's what you'll accomplish
- Synthesizing data on a regular basis to provide the DTC team with brand-level insights on business health and a clear recommendation on what to do about it, not just the numbers
- Leverage our BI tool Omni to build, maintain, and own dashboards that empower the business to interpret and act quickly. (e.g., track inventory issues across retailers and build actionable alerting.)
- Become an expert on existing DTC reporting and drive towards improvement
- Plan, design, and implement reports that highlight key performance indicators
- Enhance our A/B testing reporting suite
- Track new feature launches by Product & Engagement teams and build/manage the reporting for how they perform
- Work closely with the teams in our DTC Org to drive value for the business
- Gain a strong understanding of their data problems and use our Analytics toolkit to find a solution (What data do we need, how can we get it, and how can we automate reporting?)
- Driving deep analysis of the whats and whys of key drivers to surface hypotheses for action
- Be a strong, trusted voice and thought leader for the brands you support bringing a well-reasoned point of view to the table, and comfortable sharing it with stakeholders at all levels
- Enable your stakeholders and leaders to get sharper and smarter on the data, the business, and how we tackle our biggest questions just by working alongside you
- Bring a strong, well-reasoned point of view and advocate for the brands you support, comfortable doing so with people more senior than you
- Your impact and influence comes from how much smarter you make the people around you and your strong perspective
- Help define how we measure and report out on performance on ecommerce across key KPIs, set up dashboarding capability, and regularly track and share the overall performance of the business to drive strategic planning
- Identify analytics pain points and inefficiencies, and develop new tools and automated processes to optimize and streamline. AI is integral to the work, not an afterthought.
- Be a data-evangelist and sparring partner across the organization, sharing best practices and insights and willing to challenge the status quo with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at every level
# This may describe you
- 5+ years in data analytics or a similarly analytical field, using data to drive decision-making and narrative development in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment, with a strong understanding of the role analytics plays in a cross-disciplinary digital product development lifecycle.
- Proficient Technical Skill – Fluent in SQL (Python or R a plus), with the ability to query, manipulate, and analyze data end-to-end to accelerate the business.
- BI Tool Fluency – Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards and models in a modern BI platform. We currently run in Omni; prior experience with Looker, Tableau, or Power BI will be an enabler.
- AI-Forward – You use AI tools to speed up your own analysis, and you're comfortable helping others on the team build that same fluency.
- Business Acumen & Judgment – You connect the dots across data sources, business priorities, and customer signal, and you have a nose for which questions are worth chasing so you spend your time on the highest-impact problems, not just the interesting ones.
- Engaged Thought Partner – When someone brings you a question, they leave with a recommendation and a point of view, not just an analysis plan. You can point to specific insights that changed a real decision, not just reports you've shipped.
- Clear, Confident Communicator – You explain complex ideas simply, and you're as comfortable challenging a room full of senior stakeholders as you are presenting to them.
- You thrive on direct, honest, and supportive communication and feedback
- You are infectiously optimistic and curious To you, there’s nothing more exciting than a new challenge. Hard things are hard, but you don’t let that get in the way
# Who you will work with
- You will report to the Sr. Director of Omnichannel Analytics, with a dotted line to our VP of DTC
- Within the broader CIA org, you'll work most closely with the other data analysts and analytics engineers on the team.
- Within the larger Digital org, you’ll work closely with our DTC team (Product/Engagement/CX) as well as Distribution and Finance.
# Benefits and perks

- Equity in Mammoth Brands

- 4 weeks sabbatical after 5 years, 6 weeks after 10 years, and 8 weeks after 15 years
- 20 fully paid weeks off for parents who give birth, or 16 fully paid weeks off for all other paths to parenthood
- Fun IRL and virtual events including happy hours, team building events, and parties on our rooftop

The Mammoth Brands' working model is in-office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
Our beautiful 70,000 square foot SoHo office is decked out with bagels on Wednesdays and lunch on Thursdays, and fully stocked kitchens with snacks, coffee, and drinks everyday.
Can’t forget the free products and the opportunity to have some meetings without Zoom!
We can’t quantify all of the intangible things we think you’ll love about working at Mammoth Brands, like the exciting challenges we tackle, the smart and humble team you’ll get to work with, and our supportive and inclusive culture.
That said, our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of our total rewards package, which also includes a comprehensive set of benefits and our equity program.
